question_text: If it rains, the ground gets wet. The ground is wet. Therefore, it rained. This reasoning is:

hint_ladder.title: Spot the Pattern
hint_ladder.text: Ang pattern: 'Kung P, Q. May Q, kaya P.' Hindi laging tama—marami pang rason ang basa, gaya ng naglinis ng sasakyan.

hint_ladder.title: The Simple Rule
hint_ladder.text: Sa logic, kapag 'If P then Q' at totoo si Q, hindi mo maaaring i-conclude si P. Iba ang direction ng arrow.

hint_ladder.title: Real-Life Scenario
hint_ladder.text: Sa barangay, suspendido ang klase—akala mo may bagyo, pero seminar lang pala. Epekto ang suspend, pero hindi patunay ng bagyo.

hint_ladder.title: Name the Fallacy
hint_ladder.text: Ito ang 'affirming the consequent.' Ang consequent ay ang 'Q' (basang kalsada). Ina-affirm natin siya para sabihing totoo si P.

A.text: You might have chosen A because it looks logical, but validity forces the conclusion; here, wet ground can come from a broken pipe, so no...

B.text: You might have chosen B because true premises seem sound, but soundness also needs validity—and this argument is invalid, so not sound.

C.text: Correct. This is the affirming consequent fallacy: assuming an effect proves a specific cause when other causes exist.

D.text: You might have chosen D because Modus Tollens involves denying the consequent, but this affirms it—opposite pattern.

next_time_rule: Kapag 'If P then Q' tapos may Q, huwag mag-conclude ng P. The effect can have many causes—affirming consequent yan.
deconstruct_text:
Sa exam, isipin mo ang logic: 'Kung uulan, basa ang kalsada.' Kung basa ang kalsada, awtomatikong umulan ba? Hindi, kasi baka may naghugas ng kotse o nagbuhos ng timba. Sa barangay, kunwari suspendido ang klase—hindi ibig sabihin may bagyo; baka may seminar ang teach...

Mental trick: Isiping parang one-way street—ang cause (ulan) papunta sa effect (basang daan). Bawal umatras—hindi porke't basa, ulan na. Parang sinigang na maasim, pero hindi lahat ng maasim ay sinigang; pwedeng paksiw. Kapag nakita mo sa exam ang 'If P then Q' tapos...
